thread:
ana: hey team, starting bring-up for qbridge-v2. noticed a bunch of partial/weak labels in the seed — want a sampling + flagging plan before we run the int8/4bit quant smoke. thoughts? :wave:

sasha: +1. what do you mean by partial here? missing entity spans or truncated responses?

ana: mostly missing entity spans and clipped system messages. stats: ~18k total, ~1.1k flagged partials, gold overlap ~900. goal: 1) flag and queue partials for relabel, 2) set aside a "partial-holdout" for eval, 3) avoid wasting annotator cycles on duplicates.

jamie: propose heuristic buckets + priority score. buckets = auto-span-highconf, model-lowconf, human-marked-partial. priority = partiality_score * uncertainty + recency_boost. quick sampling config draft below:

```
sampling:
  buckets:
    auto_high: 0.2
    model_low: 0.5
    human_partial: 0.3
  dedupe_window_seconds: 86400
  prefer_golden_overlap: true
  reroll_on_contradiction: true
  min_tokens: 5
```

sasha: prefer_golden_overlap true is important — reduces noisy relabels. also recommend `fingerprint_version: v2` to catch paraphrase dups. :+1:

liam: labeler capacity next week ~1200/day. if we score and rank, top 6k can be cleared in ~5 days with focused bursts. do we want a canary relabel set (500-1k) first to validate instructions?

ana: yes, canary 500 across 3 annotators, include edge-case examples and a short rubric. also include a "do not relabel" tag when annotator can't decide.

jamie: i'll open the curation ticket and attach config + canary plan. will add `priority_threshold` and a small scheduler param to throttle relabel for low-risk buckets.

labeler-bot: batch 24 processed 2024-11-02T09:12:00Z — 120 items auto-flagged as partial, top token-length median = 18, median uncertainty = 0.62.

ana: next actions: jamie create INF ticket and attach sampling snippet; sasha run dedupe pass with v2 fingerprints and post counts; liam schedule annotators for canary and confirm capacity; i'll prepare the rubric and golden examples. check back EOD tomorrow? :white_check_mark:

sasha: running dedupe now, will post results when done.

jamie: ticket INF-3245 created and assigned to @sasha @liam @ana. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3245

ana: perfect, thanks everyone. ping me on-thread if anything blocks the canary setup.
